sections.text_helper: Section 40.6.1 "CSI-2 PHY setup" in chapter 40 (CSI-2 Host (CSI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2032.
sections.section_content:
The following actions are required to setup the CSI-2 PHY:
1. Quit the hardware reset state with PEN = 0x01 in CSI_PRCR.
2. Configure frequency settings with:
– DLD = 0x00 in CSI_PFCR (to remain in Rx)
– HSFR in CSI_PFCR that depends on the bit-rate expected on the data lanes
– CCFR = RoundUp((F - 17) × 4) in CSI_PFCR (F = configuration clock frequency)
3. Configure internal registers via the test interface, with TRSEN = TCKEN = 0x0
inCSI_PTCR0.
